title: Code and data for: Within-strain reproducibility sets the scale for cross-species comparison of diel transcriptional programs
description: Code, dataset registry, derived result tables, figures, power and null-calibration simulations, numerical provenance, semantic-assertion and mutation-test evidence, deviation log and closure report for a reanalysis of 7 public cyanobacterial diel transcriptome series (9 arms, 6 lineages, 4 platforms). The study calibrates cross-species comparison of diel transcriptional timing against an internal benchmark the field has lacked: two independent studies of the same strain. It is exploratory throughout; no pre-registration was frozen.
